definitions.explanation: A device or machine that automatically translates between languages, typically a handheld gadget that converts speech or text from one language to another. Built from {翻訳|ほんやく} (translation) + {機|き} (machine).

examples.japanese: {翻訳機|ほんやくき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{話|はな}した→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I spoke using a translation device.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{翻訳機|ほんやくき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{性能|せいのう}→性能：04340_seinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Recent translation devices perform very well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}→海外旅行：24321_kaigairyokou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{小型|こがた}→小型：12460_kogata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{翻訳機|ほんやくき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: On overseas trips, having a compact translation device reduces worries about the language.

notes:
Refers to a physical device for automatic translation, as opposed to translation software in general. Such gadgets became popular for travel as machine-translation quality improved.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{音声|おんせい}→音声：04445_onsei⟧{翻訳機|ほんやくき}: voice translation device
- {翻訳機|ほんやくき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a translation device

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{翻訳|ほんやく}→翻訳：01725_honyaku⟧⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧: translation software — programs rather than dedicated hardware
- ⟦{翻訳|ほんやく}→翻訳：01725_honyaku⟧⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧: translation app — a smartphone application doing the same job
